local totals = { NA = 0, EU = 0, APAC = 0 }
local region_cache = {}

local page = 1
repeat
  local r = tool('list_orders', { month = '2026-03', page = page })
  for _, it in ipairs(r.items) do
    local o = tool('get_order', { id = it.id })
    if o.status == 'completed' then
      local cid = o.customer_id or it.customer_id
      local region = region_cache[cid]
      if region == nil then
        local c = tool('get_customer', { id = cid })
        region = c.region
        region_cache[cid] = region
      end
      totals[region] = totals[region] + (o.amount_cents or 0)
    end
  end
  page = page + 1
until page > r.total_pages

return totals
